description: The door conditions test: door_right alone from the 50 scenes of the spawn test (after the button step of drawer_button_door, arm at a spawn pose). The drawer open or closed in the scene, times conditions rendered with the drawer open (drawer_button_door) or closed (door_switch_button, the same robot poses). In the spawn test open scene with open conditions did 4 of 50; as the first step of door_switch_button (closed, closed) the door did 25% in 400 steps. Run with dynaguide_scripts/run_homing_door_tests.bat
